q2_gaps: a proper-noun modifier inside a common-noun compound ('the Senate wing') — the casing rule ('the Brindle estuary': capitalized run = the name, adjacent lowercase noun = its kind) and the compound-kind rule (modifier_noun -> senate_wing + genus wing) give different parses, and nothing selects between them

an episodic bare plural subject ('authorities detected a material') — plural subjects are decided by determiner (bare = generic kind / rule, definite = group witness), leaving no route for a bare plural with an existential, one-off reading
'possibly' is not among the listed epistemic cues (might / probably / must), so the mapping to (Might ...) is an extension
an epistemic / modal operator inside a seal has no truth-value carrier — the confidence-0.9 rule for Might cannot be applied to a conjunct of a sealed (And ...)
